'''Givens''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], holding the rank of [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he was a member of the platoon led by [[Cadet Leader]] [[Kyle Katarn]] where they were assigned aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Imperator (Imperial-class)|''Imperator'']] to take control over [[AX-456]]. Along with [[Morely]], he was the team's demolitions expert. He was soon killed in the [[Battle of AX-456|battle]].
